profile.headline: Abeyon
profile.summary:
I have a three-year experience as a web application developer (Java Spring, JS).
During the Masters program, I gained extensive experience in advanced, applied fields (Machine Learning, Databases, CPS, Information Retrieval, etc.) and actively participated in research. 
My research focused on assisting human actions through artificial intelligence, particularly in ranking (interactive search engine algorithm) and recommendation systems. I have co-authored three papers in top conferences in the field. 

I am currently looking for a full time software developer position. I have a track record of breaths of experiences of professional engineering and teaching, interest in research with strong focus on human aspects, as well as confidence in algorithmic and programming background.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Developed new features for a logistics web application including different maintenance planning
modules for hundreds of Navy ships (Spring/JS).
● Implemented various UI and business logic updates, such as FE incorporation of
permission-based user roles, resulting in improved software usability by 15% (ExtJS/AngularJS).
● Improved error handling at the API level so that form data is better validated resulting in cleaner
database entries and a 10% reduction in support tickets.
● Member of the most productive team in completing the backlog items for the project.
● Trained, analyzed, and deployed an NLP classification model to Kubernetes instance via Docker
container that shows 20% performance improvement over a 2 year period.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Contributed to idea development & led the implementation in three academically successful projects:
1. Online Learning to Rank	
•	Information Retrieval & Interactive Computing: optimization of the ranking model from user feedback (clicks) in ad-hoc manner for personalization.
•	A Dueling Bandit problem: propose candidate gradients, compare results, finally the best performing direction is chosen to update current ranker.
•	Given dataset of query-document feature pairs, simulated user behavior is used to perform training and evaluation of the algorithms. 

2. Sensor Data Mapping	
•	Mapping time series building sensor data into groups (same room or source groups). 
•	Triplet loss and many learning to rank techniques used.
•	Metadata inference & construction of new contextual information for sensing.

3. Intelligent Agent for Air Force Drone Pilots
•	Design and analysis of an intelligent cyberattack-detection kit (a.k.a., Sentinel) on the performance of the human-machine team (HMT).
•	Realistic drone operation with cyber-attack scenarios and how pilots perform with the Sentinel in urgent situations.
•	Implemented sentinel system to assist the pilot with context of mission operation on current attack and response options.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
A graduate teaching assistant position involves course design, office hours, and grading.
- Graduate course : Machine Learning, Python for Data Science
- Undergraduate course : Software Development Methods, Human Computer Interaction

projects.title: Online Posting Board
projects.description:
Technologies: Spring Boot, JPA, OAuth, AWS, Travis
● A posting board application that features management of user posts and OAuth social login.
● A practice project to develop a Spring Boot web application from scratch (JPA, REST API).
Created/configured different AWS instances: EC2, RDS, S3. Travis for CICD.

projects.title: Scientific Literature Search Engine
projects.description:
•	A search engine system for academic research papers (similar to Google Scholar).
•	Updates its ranking model from click-through data the user makes the displayed list.
•	An implementation of an Online Learning to Rank process & a platform to test different Information retrieval techniques.
•	A platform for applying different learning to rank algorithms from research to test on real users.

publications.title: Variance Reduction in Gradient Exploration for Online Learning to Rank
publications.publisher: The 42nd International ACM SIGIR conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR '19) · Jun 1, 2019

publications.title: Can Intelligent Agent Improve Human-Machine Team Performance under Cyberattacks?
publications.publisher: The 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Human Systems Integration: Integrating People and Intelligent Systems (IHSI '19) · Feb 1, 2019
